title: OrganizerProgramDocument
description: Server-owned private wedding/corporate program root. Holds organizer ownership, lifecycle, enabled capabilities and transport tuning. Never publicly readable; guest logistics live in program-scoped collections.

timezone.description: IANA timezone identifier used for display and time-band boundaries.

rsvpDeadlineAt.description: RSVP deadline anchor for Moments scheduling; absent until the organizer sets one.

entitlement.description: Immutable snapshot of the organizer entitlement terms captured at program creation. Absent on programs predating entitlements; owning callables treat absence as the unpaid default ceiling.

householdSideLabels.description: Optional display labels for programHouseholds.side (such as bride/groom or two family names); defaults to generic partner labels.

createRequestHash.description: Immutable normalized create-command fingerprint for request-key replay. Absent on legacy programs; never changed by program edits or lifecycle transitions.

archivedAt.description: Timestamp of the explicit archive action. Lifecycle: draft/active -> completed -> archived.

archivedFromStatus.description: Status the program held before archive; unarchiveProgram restores it during the grace window.

anonymizeAt.description: Retention clock: archivedAt + 14 days. The anonymize sweep processes once this passes.

anonymizedAt.description: Set once the retention sweep scrubbed identity/free-text fields. Anonymized programs remain archived and indefinitely retained.

coverImagePath.description: Storage path of the cover photo under the programme branding folder, or null for none.

creditLine.description: The planner credit on guest pages, or null to hide it.

branding.description: How guest pages look. Optional; null once cleared. Programmes without it read as rani with no cover and no credit.
